profile.headline: Experienced Firmware Engineer that loves a challenge
profile.summary: Actively engaged firmware engineer with a demonstrated ability to quickly adapt to new and changing roles.  A professional work ethic and attitude that helps carry others to greater heights in addition to a team focus and willingness to do what's necessary to get the job done right.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and Maintained Xamarin Mobile Application Software

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description: Maintained embedded application firmware for two independent platforms, periodically adding feature support and refactoring existing logic to better meet the needs of customers. Interfaced regularly with other departments including Customer Service to ensure the quality of our products is meeting expectations.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Systems · Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) · C (Programming Language) · Embedded Software · Mobile Application Development · C# · C++

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Following the guidance of lead programmers and architects, developed and maintained the regulatory calculation engine that drives H&R Block's In-House professional tax preparation software. Worked in conjunction with fellow software engineers to update methods and practices used in coding while retaining the integrity of the tax calculations.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Development and programming of the regulatory code for the Taxworks program, a professional tax preparation software suite.
